items.text: YOU FIND A RUINED CASTLE SURROUNDED BY QUICKSAND. AN OLD WORN DRAWBRIDGE IS THE ONLY SAFE WAY ACROSS THE QUAGMIRE. WILL YOU ENTER THE RUINED CASTLE?
